integrity: All tail limits follow analytically from a bounded Gaussian variance mixture, a geometric first-long-step decomposition, and uniform Mills bounds. The standalone finite checker confirms algebraic examples and finite identities, not the infinite theorem. Publication priority remains subject to independent review.
limitations: Scalar Ornstein–Uhlenbeck model, independent two-point positive steps and independent Gaussian increments; per-update stationarity, exact arithmetic; two-sided tail rates but no convergent prefactor or physical-time stationary interpretation.
title: Rare short-step runs determine sharp Gaussian tails of randomized backward Euler–Maruyama
